title: Exception traits — LLM (phase 3)
proves: Same split in the llm plugin: a model answering in prose instead of calling a function is the node delivering (it routes through _exception), while a provider error past its retry budget marks the node red, counts in the run's errors and stops a run that asked to stop at errors.

services.what: nothing listening (the point of branch B)

notes: Branch B is what phase 3 restored: under the shipped option A a provider error concluded Done, so it could not mark the node red or stop the run. Branch B needs its own profile rather than an inline settings override — the api projection takes the resolved profile and drops the override.
